verdicts.reason: Both widen the original by pushing the lantern and cloud clusters out to the sides, which leaves empty yellow gaps between the clusters and the centre. A's 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline and SALE lanterns are shrunk, so the message is too weak and lost among the side ornaments. B keeps the headline and SALE larger and clearly dominant, but the headline sits tight to the top edge and the SALE stack is crowded right under it.
